gen-butcherman-gf-suwannaphum: Dark, raw, slot-eyed lettering that never touches its neighbors comes from Butcherman up top. But Suwannaphum, a dignified text serif with a high squared-off x-height and an open c, gives that rawness something solid to lean on.
gen-comfortaa-crimson-pro: Comfortaa draws every stroke like a neon tube, with a ring-shaped c and spacing stretched wide. Crimson Pro, a classic serif, adds a quiet shift in line weight that gives the page a softer pulse.
gen-comfortaa-fs-recia: Comfortaa keeps a marker-like constant line, with a ring-shaped c and stretched spacing. But Recia, a serif, carries its authority in a restrained difference between stem and connecting stroke.
gen-comfortaa-gf-alegreya: Letters bent from one length of neon wire define Comfortaa, friendly and geometric. Yet Alegreya, a text serif, does the quieter work, with lightly flexed strokes and wide apertures that resist filling in.
gen-comfortaa-gf-alegreya-sc: Comfortaa draws smooth, round shapes with no pinched joins or swelling bowls, all in one friendly line. Alegreya SC, a classic serif, sets crossbars a touch thinner than stems beside it and an s that never tightens.
gen-comfortaa-gf-alike-angular: Alike Angular, a text serif, tugs heavier verticals against lighter horizontals, keeping its letters held open. But Comfortaa has no vertical emphasis and no horizontal thinning, just a ring-shaped c and stretched spacing.
gen-comfortaa-gf-alyamama: Neon-tube roundness leads in Comfortaa, every stroke alike, while Alyamama, a serif, lets its curves shift gently in weight. Next to each other, they feel warm and quietly traditional.
gen-comfortaa-gf-ancizar-serif: Friendly, blueprint-like lines of constant weight make up Comfortaa. Ancizar Serif, a text serif with gentle modulation and a visibly gaping c, gives that tidy roundness a more bookish, lived-in partner.
gen-comfortaa-gf-andada-pro: Andada Pro is a classic serif with a mild shift in stroke weight. Comfortaa, with ends that look cut from the same ribbon and a ring-shaped c, supplies the uniform line that lets those counters stand out.
gen-comfortaa-gf-aref-ruqaa: Aref Ruqaa is a text serif with open bowls and mild contrast. Comfortaa bends curves with a rope's heft, while those joins taper modestly without vanishing, making a friendly, dignified mix.
